notes.title: Update 1.5, take it to the bank!
notes.content:
We present ArachnoSplat update 1.5, take it to the bank!

Added[list]
[*]Bank Level
[*]Minigun
[*]Added Fall/Halloween decorations
[*]Snap turning
[/list]

Updated[list]
[*]Made all weapons feel more "arcadey" by reducing recoil and spread
[*]Optimized the firing weapons by removing physical projectiles
[*]Added outdoor rain to Farm level
[*]Minor improvements to audio system
[/list]

As always, if you have any suggestions, bug reports or want to chat simply start a discussion on Steam (in our community group), or head over to our Discord Server.

[url=url=https://discord.gg/zxAKGeN]Discord invite link[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.3, welcome to the bunker!
notes.content:
We present ArachnoSplat update 1.3, welcome to the bunker.

Added [list][*]New bunker level
[*]P90
[*]Exploding propane tanks
[*]Bullet lines to show where the shot went[/list]

Updated [list][*]Removed multiple levels under a single spider selector and gave every level it's own spider selector since it caused confusion on how many levels there actually are
[*]Increased the number of available levels to select from a random of 1 to 3 to a total of 4 per menu load
[*]M4 fire rate buffed by 50%
[*]M4 recoil reduced by 10%
[*]MP5K fire rate buffed by 75%
[*]Fixed an out of bounds clip in the City Cafe level[/list]

As always, if you have any suggestions, bug reports or want to chat simply start a discussion on Steam (in our community group), or head over to our Discord Server.

[url=https://discord.gg/zxAKGeN]Discord invite link[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Based on input and continued development we present ArachnoSplat update 1.2.

Added [list]Farm Level (night)
M4 assault rifle to "Tool" selector

notes.title: Hot fix patch 1.01
notes.content:
This hot fix is for reported cosmetic issues and a few quality of life changes.

Added:
[list]
Speed loaders for all revolvers
Eject button for ejecting mags, opening cylinders and unlocking shotgun pumps (B for Index, B or Y for Oculus, Menu for Vive)
[/list]

Updated:
[list]
Fixed shovel wasn't stored correctly on body
Warehouse scene was brightened up
Fixed some melee items did not "squish" a spider, but did kill them
Fixed where some items broke before the player started a level
Fixed garbage bags that were disappearing in the backyard
Lowered the cabinet in the City Shop scene for more accessibility
[/list]

If you have any additional bugs or suggestion please let us know on our discord server.
[url=https://discord.gg/zxAKGeN]Discord Server Invite[/url]
